zh: 新增学期安排：一眼查看每门课在哪几周上课，点开日历查看具体日期、时间和教室。
新增可反复使用的使用指南，通过小示例学习看课表、导入、调课和设置。
改善首次打开课表时的等待和闪动，减少课程分批出现的情况。
色条显示更简洁，已结束和节假日课程的灰显更统一；课表与本周小组件可分别选择课程名靠上或居中。
桌面小组件名称更简短，可隐藏课表名称；关于页的新版本提示可以直接进入下载更新。
关于页品牌卡焕新，连续点击可持续喷射礼花；新安装或恢复默认设置后，课前提醒的提前时间为 5 分钟。
en: New semester overview: see which weeks each course runs, then open its calendar for dates, times and rooms.
A replayable user guide helps you learn timetable viewing, importing, editing and settings through interactive examples.
Reduced waiting, flashing and courses appearing in batches when first opening the timetable.
Cleaner color bars and more consistent dimming for completed and holiday classes. Choose top or centered course titles separately for the timetable and weekly widget.
Shorter widget names and an option to hide timetable names. The new-version notice in About now opens the download flow.
A refreshed brand card keeps launching confetti as you tap. New installations and restored defaults use a 5-minute lead time for class reminders.
